## August 26 Exhaustive Archival Metadata Enrichment (Increment 189)

This archival dispatch documents the comprehensive provenance, broadcast scheduling, commercial sponsorship, credited cast, production personnel, alternate circulating titles, serial multi-part narrative arcs, and story synopses for historical broadcasts transmitting on **August 26** across British radio, spanning six decades of the BBC's flagship drama anthology *Saturday Night Theatre* (1950–1989), including Hugh Burden in George Pleydell's Old Bailey courtroom thriller *The Ware Case*, Hedley Goodall in the Tolpuddle Martyrs epic *Six Men of Dorset*, Martin Jarvis in C.S. Forester's Peninsular War adventure *The Gun*, Nigel Stock in *Carrington, V.C.*, Dinsdale Landen in *The Amazing Dr. Clitterhouse*, and Lavinia Bertram & Robin Herford in Alan Ayckbourn's *Intimate Exchanges: A Game of Golf*:
